body:
Dear all, 

The proposal has been made to obsolete GO:0009274 peptidoglycan-based cell wall 
see https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/31764

Experimental annotations that need to be reviewed are here: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1U4wPkGKVgYqh-9fYkfk2t9I6WHiQv0ZJKFegwum9Za8/edit?gid=0#gid=0


CACAO	1
CAFA	21
Reactome	17
UniProt	24
EcoCyc	1

There are 4 InterPro mappings and 2 UniRule. 

Thanks, Pascale
